$description: SplitButton (platform/components/SplitButton, library wave 5, lane B): its component tokens. Both parts are Buttons (their variant, size and states); these are the join.

split-button-joined-radius.$description: SplitButton: the square corners where the two parts meet (as a button group's joined corners).

split-button-divider-width.$description: SplitButton: the divider between the parts.

split-button-primary-divider-color.$description: Primary SplitButton: the divider, the pressed step of the action color, so it shows on the fill.

split-button-disabled-divider-color.$description: Disabled primary SplitButton: the divider on the disabled fill.

split-button-focus-layer.$description: SplitButton: the focused part rises one layer so its focus ring is drawn over the other part.
